profile.biography:
Public Servant.
Former Governor of Zamfara State.
Senator representing Zamfara West.
Committed to service, leadership & national development. 🇳🇬

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
It’s encouraging to see our youths step forward with such energy, courage and a strong sense of purpose.

The massive turnout in Gusau was a remarkable demonstration of youth participation and support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

Indeed proud of @ahmadyari01 and every young person who came out. The strength and valour of our young people give us confidence in the future. They are the next generation of leaders, innovators and nation-builders who will take Nigeria forward.

#renewedhope

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
The people of Zamfara have always held a special place in the heart of His Excellency, and none more than the people of Gummi.

Two years ago, tragedy came. The floods rose, and families lost everything.

And just like he comes through for everyone, he came through for them. Quietly, the way he always does.

This is their story. Watch it to the end.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
We visited Four states in one day - Kaduna, Kano, Bauchi and Plateau.

A full day of engagements and consultations with critical stakeholders, listening, exchanging perspectives and strengthening relationships across communities.

Every conversation matters as we continue building broader support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the Renewed Hope mandate. The consultations continue.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I continued engagements in Jos and Bauchi today, meeting with Sheikh Sani Yahaya Jingir in Jos and Khalifa Sheikh Ibrahim, son of the late Sheikh Dahiru Bauchi, in Bauchi.

Our conversations centred on peace, unity and national progress, as we continue to engage important voices and communities in support of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope mandate.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As part of our ongoing consultations with critical stakeholders across the country, I met with the leadership and members of Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa Iqamatus Sunnah (JIBWIS) in Kaduna.

Our engagement provided an opportunity to exchange perspectives on national unity, peace and progress, as we continue to deepen consultations in support of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope mandate.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Still overwhelmed by the show of love, visits and condolences, and I remain deeply touched by the outpouring of care and support.

My sincere appreciation to everyone who has taken the time to visit, offer prayers and stand with my family during this period of loss.

May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Ameen.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Still overwhelmed by the love and support shown to my family and me as we laid my beloved aunt to rest.

May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Thank you for standing with us.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As we laid my beloved aunt to rest, I am deeply grateful to everyone who stood with my family and me during this difficult time.

To the dignitaries, colleagues, friends and well-wishers who visited, called, sent messages and offered their prayers and support, I sincerely appreciate every gesture of kindness.

May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Thank you.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.

We laid my beloved aunt to rest. May Almighty Allah forgive her shortcomings, grant her Aljannah Firdaus, and give our family the strength to bear this loss.

May her soul rest in eternal peace. Ameen.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.

I mourn the passing of my dear aunt, Hajiya Rakkiya Jibrin. Her kindness, warmth and the lives she touched will remain with us.

May Almighty Allah forgive her shortcomings, grant her Aljannah Firdaus, and give our family the strength to bear this loss. Amin.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I also had the honour of paying homage to His Royal Highness, the Shehu of Borno, at his Palace in Maiduguri, as part of our ongoing consultations and engagements towards the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

Our conversation reflected a shared commitment to peace, unity and the continued development of our nation. I deeply value the perspective of our traditional institutions as we take Mr President’s message of Renewed Hope to communities across Nigeria.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I had the honour of paying homage to His Royal Majesty, the Oba of Benin, as part of our ongoing consultations and engagements towards the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

I am deeply grateful for His Royal Majesty’s warm reception, wise counsel and prayers as we continue to build broad support for Mr President’s Renewed Hope mandate and the progress of our nation.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I had the honour of paying homage to His Eminence, the Sultan of Sokoto, and His Royal Majesty, the Oba of Lagos, as part of our ongoing consultations and engagements towards the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

I deeply appreciate their warm reception, wise counsel and prayers as we continue to build broad support for Mr President’s Renewed Hope mandate and the progress of our nation.

#renewedhope

posts.author: everythingyari
posts.caption:
As part of ongoing consultations and stakeholder engagements ahead of 2027, the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator @senatoraayari, earlier today led a delegation of political leaders on a visit to His Eminence, the Sultan of Sokoto.

First stop of the day: Sokoto. 📍

The Yari trail continues.

#EverythingYari

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
The flood took Hauwa’u Yushe’u’s home, along with over 2,000 others in Gumi.

Then help came, step by step. First mattresses and blankets. Then blocks, cement, and money to pay builders. Then roofing to finish the house.

Today she has a home again. She’ll tell you who did it.

Alheri. The good you do.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I met with respected Islamic scholars and religious leaders from across Zamfara State, including Chief Imams from our 14 Local Government Areas and members of the Ulamah Consultative Council.

Our discussions centred on the important role of religious leaders in promoting peace, unity and moral leadership within our communities.

We also offered prayers for Zamfara State and the continued peace, stability and progress of our nation.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I met with the APC State Working Committee and all 14 Local Government Party Chairmen, led by our State Chairman, Hon. Kabiru Moyi Birnin Magaji.

Our discussions centred on strengthening party unity, deepening coordination across the state, and ensuring that our structures remain focused and fully mobilised for the task ahead.

Together, we will continue to build a stronger and more united APC in Zamfara State.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
We were in Bungudu today.

Three years ago, the people of Bungudu/Maru handed their mandate to Hon. Abdulmalik Zubairu, our Zannan Bungudu. Today, we came home to celebrate what he has done with it.

Zannan Bungudu has served his people well. He has made the APC proud, and he has made the people who sent him prouder still. May Allah strengthen him for the work ahead.

To my people of Bungudu and Maru, thank you for standing firm with us.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
It is always a special feeling to be home today. 

Upon my arrival, I paid a courtesy visit to the Zamfara Government House, where I was warmly received by His Excellency, the Governor of Zamfara State. @dr.daudalawal I also had the opportunity to engage with members of the NURTW, pay courtesy calls on some of our respected traditional rulers, and interact with citizens across the state.

I remain deeply grateful for the warmth, goodwill and hospitality extended to me throughout the visit.

Zamfara is home, and it is always good to be back among our people.

#renewedhope

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
Hussaini wants to be a nurse, so his people will always have someone to run to when they fall sick.

School nearly ended that dream. Then the AA Yari Scholarship stepped in, and now he’s on his way.

He’s one of over 2,000 students across Zamfara being carried this way, most of whom have never met the man behind it.

The day he qualifies, the whole community wins.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Earlier today, I was at the APC Presidential Campaign Council headquarters to meet with staff, assess the facility and review our operational requirements ahead of the work before us.

As we begin the task of securing the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, our assignment is clear: build a strong organisation, put the right systems in place, mobilise our party and supporters across the country, and ensure that every part of the campaign machinery is prepared to deliver.

The work has begun, and we are fully committed to the mandate.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Years ago, I welcomed Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu to Zamfara, where he commissioned a township road built by our administration. 

Even then, he understood that infrastructure connects communities, drives commerce and fuels growth. Today, as President, that vision continues through projects like the Lagos–Calabar Coastal Highway and Sokoto–Badagry Superhighway.

The scale has changed, but the vision remains: a more connected and prosperous Nigeria.

#renewedhope #throwback

posts.author: everythingyari
posts.caption:
Earlier this month, an appointment was made in Abuja. 

Yesterday, the response came from the streets of Zamfara.

Hundreds of thousands poured into Gusau in a remarkable show of support following Senator Abdul’aziz Yari’s appointment as Director-General of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s re-election campaign.

It was a statement about Yari’s political capacity, grassroots strength, and the confidence that the people of his home state place in his ability to deliver.

President Tinubu has given him the responsibility. The people have given him their support.

Now, the work begins.

@senatoraayari

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I am deeply humbled by the incredible show of support and solidarity from our people in Zamfara for the Renewed Hope mandate and His Excellency, @officialasiwajubat 

Your energy, commitment and unwavering support are deeply appreciated. This strong demonstration of faith in our shared cause only strengthens our resolve for the journey ahead.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I proudly congratulate my son, @ahmadyari01 , On his appointment as Executive board member, Governing council for the city boy movement

I commend @seyitinubu for creating a platform that unites young Nigerians, amplifies their voices, and encourages them to help shape the nation’s future.

It’s great to see these young leaders step forward with purpose, responsibility, and a commitment to service and advance the Renewed Hope Agenda.

#renewedhope

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
Like most tertiary institutions, nearly 70% of the work is practical. But without modern equipment, students can only learn it on paper, and it never fully lands.

That was the reality at the College of Education, Bakura, until His Excellency provided a full ICT facility. Now they don’t just write it, they practise it.

Alheri. The good you do for others, quietly.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Always a delight to meet and discuss with my good friend @dapoabiodunmfr 

We had productive conversations around the journey ahead, i deeply appreciate his support and commitment as we work together to advance the Renewed Hope Agenda.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I had the pleasure of receiving Mr. Seyi Tinubu, son of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, on a courtesy visit today.

Our young people will play an important role in the journey ahead, and I look forward to working closely with youth groups and stakeholders across the country as we mobilise, engage and build the broad support needed to deliver on our mandate and advance the Renewed Hope Agenda. #renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I also received former Governor of Kogi State, His Excellency Yahaya Bello, on a courtesy visit today.

I deeply appreciate his visit, goodwill and support as we continue to advance the Renewed Hope Agenda. #renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I also had the pleasure of receiving the Chief of Staff to the President, Rt. Hon. Femi Gbajabiamila, on a courtesy visit today.

I deeply appreciate his visit, goodwill and support as we continue to advance the Renewed Hope Agenda. #renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today’s Recap

I had the pleasure of receiving Dr. Kayode Fayemi, former Governor of Ekiti State and former Minister of Mines and Steel Development, on a courtesy visit today.

I deeply appreciate his visit, goodwill and kind words. Moments like these reaffirm the importance of continued engagement and collaboration as we work together to strengthen our party and advance the Renewed Hope Agenda. #renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today’s Recap

I had the pleasure of receiving a number of distinguished leaders and stakeholders today, including the Governor of Zamfara State, His Excellency Dauda Lawal; Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa and former Minister of Aviation, Chief Femi Fani-Kayode; former Governor of Kano State and former National Chairman of the APC, Dr. Abdullahi Umar Ganduje; and former Speaker of the House of Representatives, Rt. Hon. Yakubu Dogara.

I deeply appreciate their support, goodwill and kind words as I take on this new responsibility.

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today’s Recap

Following my earlier engagement with the National Chairman of the APC, Professor Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda, I also had the pleasure of receiving courtesy visits from other distinguished leaders, party stakeholders and supporters.

I deeply appreciate their goodwill, support and kind words, and I look forward to working with everyone as we continue to advance the Renewed Hope Agenda.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Pleasure to receive the National Chairman of our great party, Professor Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda, earlier tonight at my home in Abuja.

Thank you, Mr Chairman, for the visit. I look forward to working closely with you as we get to work on our new assignment.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Glad to be back.

Ready for the task ahead

#renewedhope

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I once again accept this responsibility with humility and a firm commitment to the task ahead.

I look forward to working with our party leaders, members, stakeholders and supporters across the country as we embark on this important journey to consolidate the Renewed Hope Agenda.

The journey to victory begins.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I accept with gratitude my appointment as Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council.

The work begins now. Together, we will deliver victory in January 2027.

#APC #RenewedHope

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
66 years on the farm and Alhaji Umaru Fuloti is still planting. 🌾

In Zamfara, farming has been his life’s work. It fed his family and kept him going. But as fertilizer became harder to afford, every planting season became a struggle.

The fertilizer support from His Excellency, gave him another chance at a stronger harvest. And across Zamfara, many other farmers received that same support.

Alheri. The good you do quietly.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: yarialheri
posts.caption:
Meet Bushra. 🤍

She lost her father young and had almost given up on school. Then the AA Yari Scholarship of Sen. Abdulaziz Yari came, and the door reopened. Today she’s at FUG Zamfara, chasing her dream.

She’s one of over 2,000 students across Zamfara benefiting, most of whom have never met the man behind it.

Alheri. The good you do quietly.

#yarialheri #yarialherine

posts.author: everythingyari
posts.caption:
Thousands of people. Hundreds of vehicles. One bridge. Every single day.

An estimated 2,500 rely on the Bardoki Bridge daily, keeping people, goods, and services moving across the community.

That translates to well over 800,000 people every year. The Bardoki bridge built by Senator Yari reduces travel time, lowers transport costs, improves access to markets, schools and healthcare, and supporting local economic activity.

Infrastructure is not just about what is built. It is about the opportunities it creates and the economic value for the people that it serves.

#TheYariFiles #InfrastructureForGrowth #Zamfara

posts.author: everythingyari
posts.caption:
Did you know that Senator Abdulaziz Yari @senatoraayari personally funded and completed multiple infrastructure projects across Zamfara, separate from his constituency projects? 

Every kilometre of road, every bridge and every erosion control intervention has helped connect communities, improve livelihoods and support local economic growth. 

#TheYariFiles

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I am deeply humbled and moved by the heartfelt letter of appreciation from the APC Zamfara State and the Chairman, Hon. Tukur Umar Danfulani. It is an honor to serve the good people of Zamfara and our great party, and I am committed to continuing my efforts in service to our state and our country.

I am inspired by your recognition, and it strengthens my resolve to do even more for our communities. Together, we will keep striving for justice, peace, and unity, ensuring that no one is left behind as we build a stronger Zamfara and Nigeria.

May Almighty Allah (SWT) continue to guide and bless us all as we work towards a brighter future. 

Thank you for your trust and support!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Earlier this week, I visited His Royal Highness, the Emir of Gummi, to commiserate with him on the loss of lives and property from the recent floods. 

There, I donated 15 trucks of emergency relief supplies to the thousands of families that have been affected, and set up a committee that will look into the homes that have been damaged.

As we work to ensure that this kind of tragedy doesn’t happen again, I have directed that the committee ensures that the homes that will be rebuilt are constructed from modern and durable materials.

Together, we will overcome this challenge. 

#ZamfaraFloodRelief

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Our young people deserve a chance to shape a brighter future, filled with hope, opportunity, and their limitless potential. We must commit to supporting and guiding them every step of the way to help them achieve this.

Happy #InternationalYouthDay! 

#IYD #IYD2024

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As part of our ongoing efforts to promote dialogue and foster peace across Zamfara State and northern Nigeria, yesterday in Talata Mafara, I hosted an eminent gathering of revered Islamic Scholars, Quran Reciters, and esteemed community leaders from all 14 Local Government Areas, 19 Emirates, and 147 Wards of Zamfara.

Led by Malam Abdul’Malik Yahuza (Garkuwan Malaman Gusau), we collectively prayed for peace, blessings, and prosperity for Zamfara State and our dear country, Nigeria.

May the blessings of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) be upon us. 

Ameen.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
My late father, Alhaji Abubakar Yari, was my greatest inspiration. Baba’s teachings, lessons, and faith have helped to shape the person that I am today. 

Yesterday, I spent some time at Baba’s gravesite at Talata Mafara Central Cemetery to pray that Almighty Allah (SWT) continues to grant him a place among the righteous in Al Jannah Firdaus.

Ameen.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Transportation infrastructure provides lifelines for developing communities. It connects these communities to markets, healthcare, education, and other economic opportunities

Recognizing this need, I made a promise to the people of Bardoki in Gummi Local Government Area: to bridge the gap that isolated their community. The lack of a bridge hindered their access to essential goods, services, and opportunities — stifling aspects of their progress and development.

Today, I am proud to announce that my promise has been fulfilled. The bridge has been completed. I am confident that it will serve as a catalyst for progress and prosperity in Bardoki and beyond.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
May Almighty Allah (SWT) endow our nation and all our people with the strength, resilience, and wisdom to overcome our collective challenges. 

#SayNoToProtest

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: As he mourns the passing of his dear elder brother, the late Mallam Salihu Amadu Ribadu, who passed away last week, I paid a condolence visit to the National Security Adviser, Mallam Nuhu Ribadu, to offer my sympathies for this significant loss.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
‘HOPE AMIDST HUNGER’, airs tonight (Sunday, May 12th) on Arise Television at 6:30 PM.*

Insecurity and limited farming opportunities had made food scarce and expensive for many families in Zamfara State right before Ramadan, the Holy Month. This is why, I decided to see how I could help make lives easier by providing grains, rice, sugar, beans and other essential commodities to over 250,000 families across the 14 LGAs of Zamfara State. 

‘HOPE AMIDST HUNGER’ tells the stories of faith, resilience, and hope of some of the beneficiaries of my #YariFeeds250k initiative showcasing the positive impact it has had on their lives.

Tune in tonight at 6:30 PM* on Arise Television!

(New time: 6:30 PM)

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Earlier today with my family at the Talata Mafara Eid Ground in Zamfara State.

May Almighty Allah (SWT) answer all our prayers!

Ameen!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Barka da Sallah, and Eid Mubarak to you and your loved ones!

As we celebrate Eid al-Fitr, let us carry forward the spirit of Ramadan into every day of the year. May this festive season be a time of joy, peace, and prosperity for you and your loved ones. Let us also remember those who are less fortunate and extend our hands in charity and support, embodying the true essence of Eid.

I pray that the blessings of Allah (SWT) fill your lives with happiness, health, and prosperity!

Ameen!

#EidMubarak #barkadasallah #ramadankareem

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
1,250,000 people.
250,000 households.
358 trucks.
147 ward distribution centers.

Today, we flagged-off our Ramadan food distribution initiative at my hometown, Talata Mafara. This initiative, will benefit all the families that need it— regardless of their political affiliation.

As we work to make the lives of our people easier, I pray that Almighty Allah (SWT) will answer all our prayers during this Holy Month!  #YariFeeds250K

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As we begin the Holy Month of Ramadan, the #YariFeeds250k initiative is fully underway!

Rice, grains, beans, maize, and sugar are being distributed to 250,000 families across all 147 wards in our state, Zamfara.

May this Ramadan bring you and your loved ones peace and blessings! Ameen!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: “As we begin the Holy Month of Ramadan, we aren’t just feeding 250,000 people, we are providing 250,000 households in Zamfara State with rice, sugar, beans, maize and other commodities. That is 1,250,000 people!” —Hon. Liman, Chairman of the #YariFeeds250k Distribution Committee

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: Ahead of the commencement of the Holy Month, I am back at home in Talata Mafara!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Water sustains our families, cultivates our fields, and powers our communities. 

As we work to provide safe drinking water for all Nigerians, let’s also embrace innovative solutions to use this precious resource more efficiently in agriculture, energy, and transportation. #SDG6

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: Today, it was an honour and a pleasure to receive a former Governor of Zamfara State, His Excellency, Alhaji Mahmud Aliyu Shinkafi, Dallatun Zamfara, at my residence in Maitama, Abuja.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I joined a diverse gathering of leaders at the swearing-in of my friend, Senator Duoye Diri, for his 2nd term as Governor of Bayelsa State. 

The support from leaders of various parties solidified my belief that Governor Diri will continue to lead with purpose and dedication.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, in a display of unity and purpose, the Senate held a closed-door session with key national security stakeholders. 

This dialogue, which was attended by the National Security Adviser, the Ministers of Defense and Interior, the Service Chiefs, the Inspector-General of Police, and the Director-General of the Department of State Services, underscores the  10th Senate’s dedication to collaborative efforts in addressing the nation’s security concerns.

#Nigeria #Senate #Insecurity #Government

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
There are no words that can describe the shock, the pain, and the sadness that my family and I feel over the untimely demise of Mr. Herbert Wigwe (OON), along with his lovely wife, son, and close associate. This was indeed a monumental loss not only to Nigeria and Nigerians but to the global business community, where the mark of the late Mr. Wigwe will remain indelible.

Mr. Herbert Wigwe was an extraordinarily impactful and astute intellectual and business icon known worldwide for his unparalleled acumen and foresight. He will be dearly missed for his commitment to the upliftment of our young people, especially entrepreneurs. Additionally, his unending philanthropy and benevolence towards the poor and vulnerable will always be remembered.

His commitment to the unity and harmonious coexistence of Nigeria’s multi-ethnic groups has endeared him to a great number of people of diverse beliefs and cultures.

Mr. Wigwe lived a life of great significance; his legacy lives on, evergreen, through the lives he has touched, the destinies he has shaped, and the love that he has engraved in the hearts and minds of millions.

I extend my condolences to his family, his friends and associates, and the management and staff of Access Bank Plc.

I pray that the Almighty God comforts us all over this irreparable loss and blesses his memory.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: For their courage on the frontlines, for leaving the comfort of their homes to defend and keep us safe, for paying the ultimate price – today, on #ArmedForcesRemembranceDay – we thank our soldiers and their families for the sacrifices that they have made for Nigeria. #ThankASoldier 🇳🇬

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Happy New Year!

Welcome to 2024!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: I spent the day visiting my dear brother and friend, the  Sarkin Yamman Sokoto and former Governor of Sokoto State, His Excellency, Senator (Dr.) Aliyu Magatakarda Wamakko.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, our nation mourns the passing of a true titan – Governor Rotimi Akeredolu (SAN), my dear brother and friend.

Throughout his life, Aketi, as he was fondly called, was not only a legal luminary and a courageous leader, but also a kind and compassionate individual who always made time for others. 

His dedication to his state, Ondo, and the nation will be forever be remembered. 

At this difficult time, I pray for strength and comfort for his family, the people of Ondo State, and all who mourn Aketi’s passing. May his legacy continue to inspire us to serve with the same passion and integrity.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
From questioning the water treatment plans to asking for specifics on rural sanitation initiatives, yesterday, the Joint Senate and House Committee on Water Resources and Sanitation held its first budget defense hearing for the 2024 appropriations bill with heads of departments and agencies.

At the meeting, we delved into the budget details to ensure the efficient allocation of our national resources.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, I joined my fellow Northern Senators from the Northern Senators Forum to visit families affected by the recent airstrike in Tudun Biri village. Words cannot express the pain and suffering we witnessed firsthand. Seeing orphans, widows, and families torn apart was truly heartbreaking.

On behalf of the 58 Northern Senators, we presented a donation of N58 million to the victims. We hope this small gesture can provide some relief during this difficult time.

Our hearts ache for the families who lost loved ones. May Allah grant them a place in Al Jannah Firdaus and comfort their grieving hearts.

We pray for a speedy recovery for the injured and remain committed to supporting the affected families in any way we can.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As we continue to perform our oversight duties, yesterday, the National Assembly Joint Committee on Interior met with the Comptroller General of the Nigerian Correctional Services (NCS). This budget defense meeting focused on the NCS’s 2024 budget allocation.

At the meeting, the legislators underscored the importance of transparency. We also emphasized the need for a detailed breakdown of the inmate population and the associated costs of services that are needed to ensure that the individuals entrusted to the care of the NCS receive humane treatment.

We are committed to collaborating with all institutions to ensure that allocated resources are effectively utilized for the betterment of all Nigerians.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Today, the National Assembly had the privilege of receiving His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, as he presented the 2024 Appropriation Bill, aptly themed the “Budget of Renewed Hope.” 

This comprehensive budget proposal outlines a bold vision for Nigeria’s future, emphasizing job creation, economic stability, enhanced investment opportunities, and security reform.

We now look forward to fulfilling our oversight role to ensure that the submissions of the various ministries, departments and agencies are in-line with the overall objectives of this government.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Recognizing the critical need for accessible eye care in Zamfara West Senatorial District, my constituency office, in collaboration with Visions Savers Eye Care Center, has launched a comprehensive eye care initiative, providing free eye treatments to 1,000 individuals in Zamfara West. 

This initiative, designed to enhance the eye health of vulnerable groups, will provide my constituents with comprehensive treatment options, including surgeries, medications, and glasses, to restore and preserve their vision. 

I thank all our partners, particularly the medical professionals and our political associates, for their support in ensuring the impact of these treatments for those who need them most.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As we continue to collaborate with the Executive branch to foster a Police Force that is vigilant and responsive to the multifaceted security concerns that we face, today, the Senate approved the Nigeria Police Trust Fund budget for the year 2023.

With the allocation of these funds, our police officers will be provided with many of the necessary resources to effectively safeguard the nation with greater agility and professionalism.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Engaging in a pre-plenary discussion with the Senate President, Distinguished Senator, Godswill Akpabio.

posts.caption:
Earlier today, I paid a condolence visit to the former Accountant General of the Federation, Alhaji Ahmad Idris, in Kano State over the passing of his dear mother, Hajiya Umma.

During the visit, I prayed to Almighty Allah (SWT) to grant Mama a place among the righteous in Aljannah Firdaus.

I thank my dear brothers who joined us on this condolence visit: Zamfara State APC Chairman Hon. Tukur Umar Danfulani, Sokoto State APC Chairman Hon. Isa Achida, Senator Shehu Buba Umar, Senator Abdulrahaman Kawu Sumaila, Senator Lawal Hassan Anka, Hon. Abdulmalik Zubairu (Zannan Bungudu), Hon. Lawal M. Lawal (Gabdon Kaura), and Hon. Muhammad Gololo.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I congratulate Mr. President, His Excellency, Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu, on his victory yesterday at the Supreme Court.

The verdict is a testament to the trust that the Nigerian people have placed in Mr. President, our Vice-President, His Excellency, Sen. Kashim Shettima, and the entire leadership of our party, the APC, under the "Renewed Hope" agenda.

I pray that Almighty Allah (SWT), who has begun and sustained this administration, will continue to help us fulfill the aspirations of all the Nigerian people.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
This afternoon, I presided over the inaugural meeting of the 10th Senate’s Committee on Water Resources. At the meeting, I reiterated the Committee's commitment to working closely with the executive branch to ensure that all Nigerians have access to clean drinking water and adequate sanitation.

We will also collaborate with relevant ministries, departments, and agencies to fully harness the potential of water for energy production, irrigation, and transportation.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: Juma’at Mubarak!

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
Fiscal reform requires collaboration between the executive and the legislature — especially as we work to improve the coherence, comprehensiveness, and coordination of our taxation system.

This is why, I am pleased to be in Ikot Ekpene, Akwa Ibom State, alongside my colleagues at the Senate's retreat on fiscal policy and tax reforms. 

I am optimistic that the insights garnered from this retreat will help us to make more well-informed decisions that can stimulate our nation's economic growth.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
I would like to express my deepest condolences to Senator Dr. Ahmed Lawan, my dear colleague and friend, and our former Senate President, on the passing of his dear mother, Hajiya Halima Ibrahim.

As we mourn the loss of this remarkable woman, who dedicated her life to her family, her community, and her country, we remember her service to her community and her commitment to her faith.

In this time of grief, we pray that Almighty Allah (SWT) will grant Senator Lawan, his family, and his community comfort and peace. We also pray that He will grant Mama a place among the righteous in Al Jannah Firdaus.

Ameen.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
As families across the nation settle in to commemorate #EidElMaulud, it’s always a privilege to give back to our wonderful people in Zamfara State. This is why I am thrilled to announce that we have started the distribution of rice, maize, and cows to communities across our state.

We have allocated these foodstuffs to the 14 local government areas, to ensure that those in need across all our 147 wards will receive some level of support.

Our key beneficiaries will include the heads of households, widows, and other vulnerable groups. 

This is why I urge the committee members in charge of distributing these resources to uphold fairness in the distribution process.

As we do so, let us all remember to keep our dear state and Nigeria in our prayers for lasting peace and harmony.

Thank you all for your trust and support!

#EidElMaulud

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption: Access to Forex helps Nigerian businesses to remain competitive by importing their goods and raw materials and exporting their finished products to other markets. This is why, yesterday, at the screening of the CBN Governor, I asked him about his plans to ensure that SMEs and larger businesses have access to Forex to conduct business.

posts.author: senatoraayari
posts.caption:
#TodayInSenatePlenary, we confirmed Dr. Yemi Cardoso as the new Governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria. 

We also confirmed Mrs. Emem Nnana Usoro, Mr. Muhammad Sani Abdullahi Dattijo, Mr. Philip Ikeazor, and Dr. Bala M. Bello as Deputy Governors of the Central Bank of Nigeria.

I wish them all the best in their new roles, and hope that their collective expertise and experience will have a positive impact on Nigeria's financial stability and economic growth.
